Mojooda case load, 73 FIRs (First Information Reports) par mashru, jin mein 19 FIRs فیصل آباد, 18 FIRs لاہور, 10 FIRs راولپنڈی, 5 FIRs اسلام آباد, 5 FIRs چنیوٹ, 5 FIRs حیدر آباد, 5 FIRs کراچی ایسٹ, 5 FIRs کراچی وسطی, aur 1 FIR ملتان mein zayda tajroor hai [Document 1].  

Case mix ki taraf se, 2026 mein FIRs ki tashkili 2024 se kafi alag hai. 2024 mein sab FIRs Pakistan Penal Code (PPC) aur Arms Ordinance 1965 ki dhoondh par thi, lekin 2026 mein FIRs ki tashkili ekdam alag hai. Ab, PPC, Arms Ordinance 1965 ke alawa, Control of Narcotic Substances Act 1997 (CNSA 1997), Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act 2016 (PECA 2016), Punjab Domestic Violence Act, aur Illegal Dispossession Act 2005 bhi dhoondh mein shamil hai [Document 2].  

Arrest ki taraf se, 11 FIRs mein accused ki gharat zayda tajroor hai, lekin 62 FIRs mein koi bhi arrest record nahi hai [Document 3]. Report ki wakti tashkili ki taraf se, 2026 mein 51 FIRs par 1401.3 minutes (23.4 hours) ki average wakti tajroor hai, jis se 2024 mein 13 FIRs par 15.0 minutes ki average wakti alag hai [Document 4].  

Weapon licensing ki taraf se, 32 recovered weapons mein se 30 weapons ki license nahi hai, jis se 30 cases mein weapon ki license ki kisam zayda tajroor hai [Document 5].  

Accused ki taraf se, 92 distinct accused individuals zayda tajroor hai, jin mein se 17 accused ki umr 24 se 49 ke beech hai, aur average umr 31.5 hai. 75 accused ki umr record nahi hai, toh yeh umr aur average sirf 17 accused par lagta hai [Document 6].  

Accused aur complainant ki relationship ki taraf se, 10 FIRs mein relationship record hai, jin mein se 24 entries hai. "اجنبی (stranger)" sabse zayda aaya hai, jo 15 entries aur 6 FIRs mein zayda tajroor hai [Document 7].  

Court ki taraf se, 33 criminal records mein se 32 FIRs ab tak court mein progress par hai, aur sirf 1 FIR mein verdict record hai [Document 8].  

In sab se, afsar ko mojooda case load ki tashkili aur samajh par zayda tajroor rakhna chahiye, aur har FIR ki tashkili aur samajh par zayda tajroor rakhna chahiye.Response generated (2208 chars)

Weapon licensing ki taraf se, **30 cases** mein recovered weapon ke saath koi bhi license ki record nahi hain [Document 5].
